summary: Build practical AI literacy, prompt design, and output-checking skills for workplace tasks. Explore the five-day course and enrol.
lede: AI literacy for non-technical staff covers choosing suitable workplace tasks, designing prompts, and checking generated outputs. This course is for administrative, communications, customer service, and operations professionals who need to assess where generative AI can assist routine work while protecting sensitive information and keeping human review in place. Participants practise assessing task risks, verifying claims and bias, and documenting review steps in AI-assisted workflows.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for staff who use digital workplace tools and need practical ways to apply AI literacy to routine tasks, assess risks, and review generated material.
audience: Learning and development specialists using AI
prerequisites: Working familiarity with common workplace digital tools and routine office processes is expected. No coding or programming is required; bring examples of suitable non-sensitive work tasks for exercises.
